sender.title: Sender profile
sender.intro: These details are typed into contact forms on your behalf: prospects will reply to this email and phone number.
sender.jobTitleHint: Example: Sales manager. Some forms ask for it.
sender.emailHint: The address prospects will reply to.
sender.saveFailed: The profile could not be saved. Please try again shortly.
sender.folderNotFound: This client folder no longer exists.
sender.websiteInvalid: Enter a valid website address (example: https://mysite.com).
sender.missingDescription: Fill it in before preparing forms: without it, Prospectigo does not know what to write.
sender.listIntro: Each campaign uses the default sender unless you pick another one for it (Write step).
sender.deleteDescription: {name} will be deleted. Campaigns using it will switch to the default sender.
sender.deleteFailed: The sender could not be deleted. Please try again in a moment.
sender.deleteForbidden: Only members who manage the organization settings can delete a sender.

messages.title: Campaign messages
messages.intro: Write up to 4 messages: they are sent in turn to see which one works best. Variables in braces are replaced for each prospect. If a piece of information is missing for a prospect (no rating, no reviews…), the sentence containing it is removed automatically.
messages.shortIntro: Some websites limit the message length. This version of up to 200 characters is then sent instead of this message.
messages.bodyPlaceholder:
Hello,

We took a look at your business's online presence…
messages.previewDescription: The message as it will be written for three real prospects of this folder.
messages.previewEmpty: No prospect in this folder yet: the preview will appear once a campaign has found some.
messages.previewNoText: Write a message to see the preview.
messages.companyMissingWarning: Your company must appear in the message: insert the “Your company” variable or write its name.
messages.noSenderWarning: The sender profile is not filled in: the preview leaves your details empty.
messages.saved: {count, plural, =0 {Messages saved (none filled in).} one {# message saved.} other {# messages saved.}}
messages.saveFailed: The messages could not be saved. Please try again shortly.
messages.companyMissing: Each message must mention your company (the “Your company” variable or its name).
messages.unknownVariable: A message contains an unknown variable. Check the braces.
messages.shortTooLong: The short version must not exceed 200 characters.
messages.detailCount: {count, plural, =0 {No message} one {# message} other {# messages}}
messages.detailMissing: Write at least one message before preparing forms.
messages.autoValidationPlan: Automatic validation is not included in your plan.

sending.title: Sending
sending.intro: These settings apply to this campaign.
sending.dailyLimitHint: Prospectigo never sends more forms than this number per day for this campaign.
sending.autoValidationHint: A form prepared without any warning is validated on its own, without review. Forms to complete or with a remark still wait for your review.
sending.autoValidationPlanHint: Available as soon as you have a plan.
sending.autoValidationWarning: Warning: automatically validated forms will be sent as soon as sending is active, without your review.

messages.shortPlaceholder: Hello, we have a simple idea for '{company}'…

forms.intro: The contact forms Prospectigo filled in. Autopilot forms go out on their own; the others wait for your approval.

groupHints.ready: The form is filled in. Check the screenshot and the message, then validate.
groupHints.incomplete: The site asks for something Prospectigo does not have: open the form and fill it in.
groupHints.intervention_required: The site is protected by a captcha. Prospectigo did not solve it: you can send by hand from the site.
groupHints.validated: Validated by you. Prospectigo sends them during the day, within the campaign's daily limit.
groupHints.preparing: Prospectigo is working. This list refreshes by itself.
groupHints.no_form: No contact form found. When an email address was spotted on the site, it is saved on the prospect.
groupHints.unreachable: Site unreachable, error, or a send that failed. You can relaunch the preparation from the Prospects page.
groupHints.sent: Forms sent (confirmation seen on the site). Sending doesn't use any credits.
groupHints.to_verify: Prospectigo clicked Send but saw no clear confirmation. Look at the after-send screenshot and decide: delivered or not.

forms.emptyHint: To prepare some: open a campaign, “Sending” step.
